payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the semantic tagset used, including its structure and purpose.

claims.text: The semantic tagset consists of 80 semantic tags grouped in 13 coarse-grained classes.
The semantic tagset is designed to assign language-neutral semantic categories to words, overcoming limitations of traditional part-of-speech tagsets.
The tagset originated in the Parallel Meaning Bank (PMB) project and contributes to compositional semantics and cross-lingual projection.
